title: Intent-to-Mission Planner
goal: Convert natural-language operator intent into a complete mission configuration, target scope, assessment depth, authorization summary, run mode, and evidence plan. Clear requests such as 'do a full pentest on this URL' must not trigger redundant follow-up questions asking whether a full pentest is desired.
scope: AI intake, mission planning, and launch summary.
generation_reason: The intake should behave like a real assistant that understands operator intent and platform capabilities instead of a language-specific regex or scripted questionnaire.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Intent parsing must not bypass explicit ROE authorization, scope confirmation, exploitation tier, credential consent, or kill-switch gates.

success_criteria: The planner maps multilingual clear intent to target, assessment type, depth, run_mode, authorization summary, and launch-ready configuration.
The planner asks follow-up questions only for genuinely missing or unsafe information.
The launch summary states exactly what will run automatically, what requires approval, and what is out of scope.

acceptance_criteria: Dutch and English full-pentest requests produce launch-ready mission previews without redundant full-pentest confirmation.
Missing ROE authorization still blocks launch with a clear required action.
Manual wizard path remains available and unchanged.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Using regex-only language detection as the final architecture
